purpose: Check whether direct text-conditioned segmentation is a distinct future option after the frozen GroundingDINO-to-box-to-SAM2.1 ownership failures. This is not a selected or executed candidate.

sources.type: Official Meta repository README, current web read
Official Meta model card, current web read

verified_from_official_documents.capability: SAM3 supports concept segmentation from short text or exemplar prompts, whereas the executed SAM2.1 stage was box-only. The official SAM3 card includes combined text and geometric prompts.
verified_from_official_documents.official_repository_prerequisites: Python>=3.12, PyTorch>=2.7, CUDA>=12.6. The existing successfully used local environments have Torch2.5.1+cu121; the documented stack is different.
verified_from_official_documents.checkpoint_access: The official model card presents an access agreement involving sharing Hugging Face information, and the README requires accepted/authenticated checkpoint access.
verified_from_official_documents.latest_repository_note: The README reports SAM3.1 object-multiplex release on2026-03-27. No claim that this video-tracking update solves the current image/keypoint task.

not_verified_or_done: Whether the user's account already has model access
interpretation_KO: 텍스트를 segmentation까지 전달하는 경로는 box-only SAM2.1과 다른 후보입니다. 다만 더 좋은 target mask도 가상 코너 영상 단서의 D/E/S 정답을 대신하지 않습니다. 현재는 새 설치나 gated 접근을 진행하지 않고 공개 source의 코너·부분선 단서와 감독 목표를 먼저 확인합니다.
